content: पस्पशः .²1 <ab>N.</ab> of the first Āhnika of the first chapter of Patañjaliʼs Mahābhāṣya; शब्दविद्येव नो भाति राजनीतिरपस्पशा <ls>Śi. 2. 112</ls> (where अपस्पश also means ‘without spies’). .²2 (<ab>Fig.</ab>) An introductory chapter in general (उपोद्घात). .{@-शाः@} <ab>N.</ab> of the introduction of the Mahābhāṣya.
